description: Memory and caching: Redis short-term memory with in-memory fallback, Postgres+pgvector long-term memory with in-memory vector fallback, and a semantic cache with a configurable similarity threshold over a store separate from LTM. All fallbacks are the offline default. Depends on FEAT-002 (embeddings). Independent of FEAT-004/005 but ordered before them.
steps: Create app/memory/stm_base.py (STM Protocol get/set/delete scoped by session_id), stm_memory.py (InMemorySTM: per-session dict with TTL timestamps, enforces session isolation so one session never reads another's keys; default), stm_redis.py (RedisSTM: import-guarded redis, namespaced keys queryn:stm:{session}:{k} with EXPIRE, selected only when Redis pings successfully, any Redis error after selection caught per-call and falls back to in-memory for that request with a structured warning).

Create app/memory/ltm_base.py (LTM Protocol store(content, metadata)->id and retrieve(query, k, filters)->list[record]), ltm_memory.py (InMemoryLTM: keeps (id, vector, content, metadata) and ranks by cosine top-k using embed(); default), ltm_pgvector.py (PgVectorLTM: import-guarded psycopg against a vector column with <=> ordering, idempotent DDL on startup when configured, fallback to in-memory on connection failure).

Create app/memory/cache.py: a semantic cache storing (query_embedding, ResearchResult) pairs in a store instance SEPARATE from LTM, sharing only embed(); lookup(query) returns the stored ResearchResult with cache_hit=True iff the best cosine >= the configurable threshold (QUERYN_CACHE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, default 0.95), else miss; stored results never enter the LTM store. No source field.
Create app/memory/factory.py building the selected STM, LTM, and cache from settings.

Create tests/unit/test_stm.py, tests/unit/test_ltm.py, tests/unit/test_cache.py covering the acceptance criteria. For the cache-hit test use an identical or single-token-delta query pair so deterministic cosine >= 0.95 is reliable (carry-forward); for the threshold-flip test straddle the threshold with a borderline pair.
acceptance_criteria: With REDIS_URL unset, STM uses the in-memory fallback and a read for session B never returns session A data; TTL expiry works
With DATABASE_URL unset, LTM uses the in-memory vector fallback and returns top-k semantically relevant records via the deterministic embedding
Two queries at or above the configured threshold produce a cache hit marked cache_hit=True; a below-threshold pair is a miss
Changing the threshold via config flips a borderline pair across the hit/miss boundary
Cached full results do not appear in LTM retrieval (separate store)
uv run mypy app/memory reports no errors
No file created in this feature contains a comment or docstring
verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_stm.py tests/unit/test_ltm.py tests/unit/test_cache.py
findings: Implemented app/memory: stm_base.ShortTermMemory Protocol (get/set/delete, ttl_seconds param on set), stm_memory.InMemorySTM (per-session dict, monotonic-clock TTL, session isolation; offline default), stm_redis.RedisSTM (import-guarded via importlib.import_module('redis') to match tensorzero_gw pattern and keep mypy clean without types-redis; namespaced keys queryn:stm:{session}:{k} with EXPIRE via SET ex=; RedisSTM.connect() pings then returns; per-call errors caught -> in-memory fallback + structured 'redis_stm_fallback' warning). ltm_base.LongTermMemory Protocol + LTMRecord TypedDict {id,content,metadata,score}; ltm_memory.InMemoryLTM (embed()+cosine top-k, metadata-equality filters; default); ltm_pgvector.PgVectorLTM (import-guarded psycopg via importlib; idempotent DDL creates vector extension + queryn_ltm table with vector(256) column in PgVectorLTM.connect(); retrieve orders by '<=>' and returns score=1-distance; metadata @> jsonb filters; per-call fallback to in-memory on error). cache.SemanticCache is Generic[ResultT] bound to a CacheableResult Protocol (just a settable cache_hit: bool) because api/schemas.ResearchResult does NOT exist yet (FEAT ordered before the API/schemas feature) -- when that schema lands, parameterize SemanticCache[ResearchResult]; the cache has NO source field, uses a store SEPARATE from LTM, shares only embed(), and on hit (best cosine >= threshold, strict >=) sets result.cache_hit=True. factory.build_stm/build_ltm/build_cache select via resolve_modes and fall back to in-memory with structured warnings; build_cache threshold = settings.cache_similarity_threshold (QUERYN_CACHE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD default 0.95). NO comments/docstrings in any file. Generics use classic TypeVar+Generic (NOT PEP 695 'class X[T]') because requires-python is 3.11. Deterministic embedding cosines used by tests: single-token-delta hit pair cosine 0.9535 (>=0.95); borderline pair 'machine learning model training' vs '...training data' cosine 0.8944 (miss at 0.95, hit at 0.8) for the threshold-flip test. No dependency/version changes. Verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_stm.py tests/unit/test_ltm.py tests/unit/test_cache.py -> 17 passed; uv run mypy app/memory -> clean; uv run ruff check . -> clean; full suite 49 passed.
